acceptance_criteria: All 7 tests pass. u32::MAX pathLen test passes with no overflow. Saturating arithmetic confirmed in code review.
description:
Add the remaining per-cert checks to the walk loop from PKIX-vxf, plus the
pathLenConstraint state machine.

## What (added inside the walk loop, after sig+name checks)

### Per every cert (leaf and intermediates)
  c. check_validity(cert[i], policy.current_time_unix)
     -> Err(Error::ValidityPeriod { index: i })
  d. check_critical_extensions(cert[i])
     -> Err(Error::UnhandledCriticalExtension { index: i })

### Per intermediate only (i > 0)
  e. BasicConstraints cA=TRUE required
     -> Err(Error::NotCA { index: i })
  f. KeyUsage keyCertSign required (when policy.enforce_key_usage=true)
     -> Err(Error::KeyUsageMissing { index: i })

### pathLenConstraint state machine (RFC 5280 §6.1.4(l)(m))
  Initialize: max_path_length = policy.max_path_len
  For each intermediate cert, if BasicConstraints.pathLenConstraint present:
    let plen = cert.path_len_constraint as u64;  // widen from u32 first
    if (plen as u8) < max_path_length (saturating) -> update max_path_length
  After processing each intermediate, check remaining depth against max_path_length
    -> Err(Error::PathTooLong)

## Arithmetic safety requirements
- NEVER do bare u8 decrement on max_path_length (underflow risk)
- x509-cert represents pathLenConstraint as u32; u32::MAX must not overflow when
  compared against u8 max_path_length. Use saturating_add/min/checked arithmetic.
- Tested with pathLenConstraint = 0, 1, u32::MAX

## Tests (externally-generated DER; openssl verify as oracle)
- Expired leaf -> ValidityPeriod { index: 0 }
- Not-yet-valid intermediate -> ValidityPeriod { index: 1 }
- Unknown critical extension on leaf -> UnhandledCriticalExtension { index: 0 }
- Intermediate without BasicConstraints cA=TRUE -> NotCA { index: 1 }
- Intermediate without KeyUsage keyCertSign -> KeyUsageMissing { index: 1 }
- pathLenConstraint=0 on intermediate, chain has one more intermediate -> PathTooLong
- pathLenConstraint=u32::MAX on intermediate, no overflow

## Depends on
PKIX-vxf (walk loop skeleton), PKIX-047 (validity checker), PKIX-0q5 (BasicConstraints+pathLen extraction), PKIX-8ae (KeyUsage extraction), PKIX-ad6 (critical extension guard)
title: pkix-path: per-cert validity, critical extensions, and intermediate CA enforcement
